workarounds.note: renderToPdf asks resourceBytes for svg.fileId and never for svg.pdfFileId, so pressPdf() answers each drawing's SVG id with the bytes of its print master (what bundleResourceBytes does for a .postext bundle)
the PDF asks for the bold, italic and bold-italic faces of every family, Space Grotesk's missing italic included: the kit's provider snaps weights and falls back to upright
the room texts are ragged and so never hyphenated; the measure stays at 118 mm and nothing claims hyphenation
config.locale does not name the figures: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand, with one running count
the rooms' level-1 headings state breakBefore: { enabled: false }, since any headings object drops the default break; the back cover breaks through its heading style
col() writes the hex beside the paletteId, because design elements read the hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the cover's map, a bleed-anchored image, reserves no height, so the text puts :::pagebreak after the cover heading; without it the lead and the first room print over the map

crop marks start markOffset outside the trim, not outside the bleed, so a bleed wider than the 3 mm default offset puts the marks on the artwork (canvas and PDF): cutLines sets markOffset: mm(BLEED) so one number keeps them clear
renderToPdf never reads config.pdfGeneration, so pressPdf() passes colorSpace as a renderToPdf option, and the bookmarks and page labels come from its defaults
